part: A2: the Shared worlds Test button (clickText 'Test' in part A hit another panel's Test first; this one is found under the Shared worlds heading and clicked through the DOM)

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('ws://127.0.0.1:8796\n'); return at < 0 ? 'no probe line' : t.slice(at, at + 400) })()
